description: Unique identifier for each order transaction
notes: Primary key - never null - uniquely identifies each warehouse order

description: Unique identifier linking to customer master
notes: Foreign key to customers table - critical for revenue tracking and churn analysis

description: Warehouse location code where order was processed
notes: Can be null for system failures - affects warehouse performance metrics
Currency in USD - never null for completed transactions - used for all revenue calculations

business_meaning: Current state of order through pipeline
notes: Values: completed/pending/failed/cancelled - critical for distinguishing recognized revenue vs. pending
Values: Picking/Packaging/Sorting/Packing - used to segregate performance metrics by process type

description: Minutes to prepare/process order at warehouse
notes: Should be positive - null indicates incomplete workflow - higher values indicate bottlenecks
Range 0-100% - values above 100% indicate data quality issues - directly impacts customer satisfaction

description: Count of complaints from this order
notes: Values 0 or greater - null indicates missing data - used for quality trending and workflow impact analysis
ISO 8601 format YYYY-MM-DD - never null - used for cohort analysis and tenure calculations
Minimum 50 characters - can be null for anonymized data - used for customer communications and KYC
